title: SOUL_IS_THE_SECRET_INGREDIENT

definition.SOUL: The exact characters (letters) of the operator's verbatim prompts per session. Not the aggregate of all chats.
definition.secret_ingredient_of_pheromones: SOUL — every pheromone must be rooted in the operator's actual words/signal
definition.per_session_receipts: When /SOULaudit is given: (1) provide the exact character count of verbatim prompts from session rise/inception up to command time; (2) provide receipts of the exact SOULscripts (prompts in chronological order) for that specific session.
definition.aggregate_disowned: The 239k aggregate number is SCRAPPED. Operator (run158 SOUL source line 111): 'scrap that useless 239k number now, I dont want to see it ever again'. The live endpoint still returns 239,645,670 aggregate — that number is NOT SOUL. Do not report it as SOUL.
